sloka: जानासि त्वं यथा सौम्य दण्डके विजने वने ।रावणेन हृता सीता स च विध्वंसितो मया ।। ७.४५.५ ॥
transliteration: jānāsi tvaṁ yathā saumya daṇḍake vijane vane ।rāvaṇena hṛtā sītā sa ca vidhvaṁsito mayā ।। 7.45.5 ॥

translations.english: He reminded them, "O gentle one, you know how Sita was abducted by Ravana in the solitary Dandaka forest, and how I subsequently destroyed him."
